title_zh: 維斯帕拉德 第 17 章
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域

segments.orig:
ashem vohû...(3). aiwi-geredhmahi ýasnahe haptanghâtôish
humataca hûxtaca hvarshtaca, aiwi-geredhmahi ashem vohû....
(...aiwi-geredhmahi ... ashem vohû...(3)!!)
segments.en:
And we strive after the good thoughts, words, and deeds inculcated
in the Yasna Haptanghaiti. A blessing is the Right (called) the
Best, (there is) weal; (there is) weal for this (man) when toward
Righteousness Best (there is) right.
segments.zh: 我們努力追求在七章禱中所灌輸的善思、善言、善行。祝福就是正義（稱為）最善，（有）福祉；（對此人而言）當向最善的正義時，（有）福祉；正義。
